# Fate UI v0.8.10-beta10

Switching folders no longer blocks on another folder's startup, and compact conversation paths now match the unified session row design.

## Multi-folder and sidebar fixes

- **Switch folders while another is starting.** Folder focus/open now bypasses the global navigation-busy gate. Folders are isolated Pi agents, so clicking a folder (or a session in another folder) while the focused folder is still "Starting" or streaming now works. The project-navigation generation discards superseded results and the activation queue serializes the opens.
- **Compact conversation paths normalized.** Fork / worktree path rows in compact mode now match the unified 26px session-row design (single-line title + meta) instead of the older taller path rows.

## Known follow-ups (not in this build)

- Fork / worktree path click sometimes stays on "current path" and the per-fork controls (compact / rename / delete) need the SDK's branch operations, which I want to verify against the real Pi runtime before shipping. Fork/worktree creation speed is bounded by the SDK writing the new session transcript.

## Compatibility and installers

No migration is needed. Existing projects, Pi sessions, settings, themes, and folder history are unchanged.

GitHub Actions builds and tests this release on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64. The prerelease contains installers plus `SHA256SUMS`:

- Windows x64: NSIS `.exe`
- macOS arm64 and x64: `.dmg` and `.pkg`
- Linux x64: `.AppImage` and `.deb`

Public beta installers remain unsigned. Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may show an unknown-publisher warning. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.
